blocks.text: Yeh principle (usool) sab se pehle Dutch scientist Christiaan Huygens ne bayan kiya. Yeh aik geometrical tareeqa hai: kisi lamhe par wavefront ki shakal maloom ho to is se kuch der baad wavefront ki shakal nikali ja sakti hai. Huygens ne farz kiya ke wavefront ka har point secondary wavelets (chhoti chhoti nayi lehron) ka source hai, jo har simt usi speed se phailti hain jis speed se asal wave chal rahi hai.
Kuch der baad ka naya wavefront woh satah hai jo tamam secondary wavelets ko bahar se chhooti (tangent) hai. Is satah ko wavelets ka envelope (gherne wali satah) kehte hain.

Fig. 15.2 Huygens ka principle dikhati hai. Asal wavefront AB source se bahar ki taraf chal raha hai, jaisa teer dikhate hain. Hamein waqt t ke baad wavefront ki shakal maloom karni hai. Farz karein ke wave ki speed v har jagah aik jaisi hai. To waqt t mein wavefront vt faasla tay karta hai. AB ke kai points ko markaz (centre) bana kar radius vt ke daire banayein (yeh spherical wavelets ke nishan hain). In wavelets ka envelope, yani curve CD, naya wavefront hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf source S aur us ke daen kham-daar primary wavefront AB jis par saat nuqte hain. Har nuqte se radius vt ka secondary wavelet bana hai; aik gulabi lakeer aik radius dikhati hai aur vt wala teer harkat ki simt. Tamam wavelets ko chhoti hui lakeer CD secondary wavefront hai; aik chhoti qaus par wavelet likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.2: Pichhle wavefront se naye wavefront ka banna (kitab ki Figure 15.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein primary wavefront ke oopar wale sire par 'S' aur teer par 'yt' chhapa hai. Matan (text) ke mutabiq yeh A aur vt hain: wavefront AB hai aur har wavelet ka radius vt hai (raftar v guna waqt t). Khaake mein A aur vt likha hai. Naya wavefront CD tamam wavelets ko chhoone wali lakeer (envelope) hai.
Huygens ke principle se jo nataij milte hain woh sab Maxwell ki equations se bhi nikalte hain, lekin Huygens ka saada model istemal karna aasan hai.

blocks.prompt: Kya Huygens ka principle awaz aur pani ki lehron par bhi laagu hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Haan. Yeh har us wave par laagu hai jo muqarrara speed se chalti ho, is liye awaz aur pani ki lehron ka phailna aur murna bhi isi tarah samjha ja sakta hai.

items: Wavefront ka har point secondary wavelets ka source hai.
Waqt t ke baad naya wavefront = radius vt wale wavelets ka envelope (CD).
Yahi nataij Maxwell ki equations se bhi milte hain; Huygens ka model aasan hai.
